2609.06165.title: Multiple Myeloma Lesion Segmentation on Whole-Body Diffusion-Weighted Imaging via Efficient Anatomical Anticipation and Multimodal Confirmation
2609.06165.paper_summary: Whole-body diffusion-weighted imaging (WB-DWI) is widely used for multiple myeloma (MM) assessment, yet automated lesion segmentation remains challenging due to limited anatomical delineation and the low specificity of marrow hyperintensity. Existing studies have introduced bone region-of-interest (ROI) information and apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) maps to mitigate these ambiguities, but practical limitations remain. Bone ROI construction often relies on costly manual annotation, image registration, or dedicated bone models, while ADC is usually incorporated only through simple channel fusion, limiting its ability to provide complementary structural and lesion-discriminative cues. To address these limitations, we propose a two-stage framework for MM lesion segmentation on WB-DWI. In the first stage, we train a bone ROI generation model from ADC images without dedicated bone labels, providing an efficient and practical anatomical prior for lesion analysis. In the second stage, we propose Anatomy-guided Multimodal U-Net (AMU-Net), which leverages ADC in a manner consistent with clinical lesion assessment rather than treating it as a generic auxiliary modality. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and practicality of the proposed method. It achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated methods, with a mean Dice score of 76.2%.
2609.06165.paper_summary_zh: 全身擴散加權成像 (WB-DWI) 被廣泛應用於多發性骨髓瘤 (MM) 的評估，但由於解剖界線有限以及骨髓高信號的低特異性，自動病變分割仍然具有挑戰性。現有研究已引入骨區域興趣 (ROI) 資訊和明顯擴散係數 (ADC) 圖來減輕這些模糊性，但仍然存在實際限制。骨 ROI 的構建通常依賴於昂貴的手動標註、影像註冊或專用骨模型，而 ADC 通常僅通過簡單的通道融合來整合，限制了其提供補充結構和病變區分線索的能力。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了一個針對 WB-DWI 上 MM 病變分割的兩階段框架。在第一階段，我們從 ADC 圖像中訓練一個骨 ROI 生成模型，無需專用的骨標籤，為病變分析提供了一個高效且實用的解剖先驗知識。在第二階段，我們提出了基於解剖學的多模態 U-Net (AMU-Net)，它以與臨床病變評估一致的方式利用 ADC，而不是將其視為通用的輔助模態。廣泛的實驗證明了所提方法的有效性和實用性。它在評估的方法中實現了最佳的整體性能，平均 Dice 分數為 76.2%。
